scenarios.title: Stairs down to a closed door
scenarios.problem: A person with low vision heads down indoor stairs.

vision.seen: Stairs with a white handrail lead down past wall signs to a closed white door with a dark rectangular mat in front of it.
vision.say_now: Watch for the steps going down and the dark mat on the floor. A closed white door is about one step ahead with the handle on your left.
vision.summary: Descended stairs to a closed white door with a floor mat.
vision.caregiver_note: Walking down stairs toward a closed door past a Green Room sign.

scenarios.title: Steps up to a door at night
scenarios.problem: Climbing outdoor steps in poor light.

vision.seen: A dimly lit flight of about six steps leads straight ahead up to a closed wooden door with a small dark object on the top landing to the right.
hazards: Dimly lit flight of steps going up
Small dark object on the top landing to the right
vision.say_now: Careful, there is a dimly lit flight of about six steps right in front of you at twelve o'clock. A closed door is straight ahead at the top.
vision.summary: Facing dimly lit steps leading up to a closed door.
vision.caregiver_note: User is at a dimly lit staircase leading up to a closed door at night.

scenarios.title: Night steps down to the street
scenarios.problem: Fall risk: wide steps, a handrail and parked cars below.

vision.seen: Dim concrete steps with a handrail lead down to a flat sidewalk facing a curb, parked cars, and a street at night.
vision.say_now: Hold the handrail on your right as you take these dim steps slowly. Stop on the flat sidewalk at the bottom before the curb.
vision.summary: Walking down dim outdoor steps with a handrail toward a sidewalk and street.
vision.caregiver_note: Navigating dim outdoor steps at night toward a street curb; no seating visible in view.

scenarios.title: Where are my glasses?
scenarios.problem: Grandpa can't find his glasses for the third time today.

vision.seen: A person's hands are on a wooden kitchen table beside a blue mug and a pair of round glasses.
vision.say_now: You are in the kitchen by the wooden table. Your glasses are right there next to the blue mug.
vision.summary: Hands on a wooden kitchen table next to a blue mug and round glasses.

scenarios.title: Did I take my pills?
scenarios.problem: Unsure whether this morning's tablets were taken.

vision.seen: A person's hand is touching a colourful pill organiser on a wooden table next to a glass of water and a plate.
vision.say_now: You are at the table with your pill organiser and water. I can't confirm that; let's check the pill organiser together or ask your caregiver.
vision.summary: Person at the table checking a colourful pill organiser next to a glass of water.
vision.caregiver_note: Seen handling the pill organiser at the table; may need help confirming medication.

scenarios.title: Which key is it?
scenarios.problem: A grandfather stands at his own front door, unsure of the key.

vision.seen: An older man in a knit cardigan is standing in a hallway near a wooden door, looking down at a set of keys in his hands.
vision.say_now: You are standing by the hallway door with your keys in your hands. I am not sure which key goes to this door, so we can ask your caregiver if you would like help.
vision.summary: Standing in the hallway holding a set of keys and looking unsure.
vision.caregiver_note: He appeared uncertain about which key to use near the hallway door.

scenarios.title: Stove left on
scenarios.problem: A pan is left on a lit burner while she sits down.

vision.seen: An older person walks from the kitchen to sit on a living room sofa while a pan sits over a lit stove flame behind them.
vision.say_now: You just sat down on the sofa. The stove in the kitchen is still on, so let's turn it off.
vision.summary: Person sat on the sofa and left a lit stove burner unattended in the kitchen.
vision.caregiver_note: A lit stove burner with a pan on it was left unattended after they walked to the sofa.

scenarios.title: Waiting at a crossing
scenarios.problem: A blind woman with a cane waits to cross a busy street.

vision.seen: A woman holding a white cane is standing on a pedestrian crosswalk with moving cars and a bus behind her.
vision.say_now: There is moving traffic ahead from left to right. At 12 o'clock, a few steps in front of you, a person with a white cane is standing on a crosswalk.
vision.summary: Facing a busy street crossing with moving traffic and a person holding a white cane ahead.
vision.caregiver_note: User is near a busy crosswalk with active vehicle traffic.

scenarios.title: Reading medicine labels
scenarios.problem: Finding the right box on a pharmacy shelf without sight.

vision.seen: A pharmacy shelf is in front of you, focusing on two pink boxes on the top end shelf.
vision.say_now: A shelf corner is right ahead at twelve o'clock with two pink boxes on top. The labels are too blurry to read, so please move closer or turn a box.
vision.summary: Viewing two pink boxes on a store shelf; label text is unreadable.
vision.caregiver_note: Looking at boxes on a pharmacy shelf; labels were too blurry to read.

scenarios.title: Doorbell at night
scenarios.problem: Someone is at the door and the bell can't be heard.

vision.seen: In a dimly lit living room at dusk, a woman wearing light blue scrubs is standing outside the glass door holding a brown box and waving.
vision.say_now: Someone in light blue scrubs is at the glass door holding a box. She is smiling and waving.
vision.summary: A person in scrubs holding a box is waving outside the glass door at night.
vision.caregiver_note: Someone in scrubs holding a package is at the door waving; I cannot confirm their identity or whether a doorbell rang.

scenarios.title: Kettle boiling over
scenarios.problem: Working with headphones, missing the kettle and alarm.

vision.seen: A person sits at a wooden table using a laptop while a kettle and pot steam heavily on the stove behind them and a device on the counter glows red.
hazards: Heavy steam from kettle and pot on stove
vision.say_now: ALERT: The stove behind you is steaming heavily. Please check the kettle and pot now.
vision.summary: Person at laptop with kettle and pot steaming heavily on stove behind them.
vision.caregiver_note: Kettle and pot were steaming heavily on the stove behind the person while they used a laptop.

scenarios.title: Cluttered hallway
scenarios.problem: A wheelchair user meets a folded rug and shoes on the floor.

vision.seen: A dimly lit hallway shows a person in a wheelchair turning left over a rug that is bunching up, with a pair of shoes on the floor to the right.
vision.say_now: There is a bunched-up rug ahead and shoes along the right wall. Please stay seated safely and take the clear floor space slowly.
vision.summary: Dim hallway with a bunched-up rug catching a wheelchair wheel and shoes on the floor.
vision.caregiver_note: Secure or remove the loose rug at the end of the hallway, clear the shoes, and improve hallway lighting.

scenarios.title: No ramp at the kerb
scenarios.problem: A wheelchair user looks for a lowered kerb.

vision.seen: A person in a wheelchair is stopped on a shaded city pavement next to a raised concrete barrier and a kerb with no ramp, with an A-frame sign ahead.
vision.say_now: There is a raised kerb right in front of you with no ramp. Stay on the flat pavement to your left and pause if you need help finding a crossing.
vision.summary: Wheelchair user stopped by a raised concrete kerb without a ramp on a shaded pavement.
vision.caregiver_note: Stopped at a raised kerb with no ramp while navigating the pavement.

scenarios.title: On the floor by the armchair
scenarios.problem: An older man has lost his balance and sits on the floor.

vision.seen: An older man is sitting on the carpeted floor beside a large armchair in a dimly lit living room.
vision.say_now: Please stay still right where you are. Let's call your caregiver or emergency services for help now.
vision.summary: Person is on the floor beside the armchair and appears to need help.
vision.caregiver_note: He is sitting on the floor next to the armchair and may have fallen.

scenarios.title: Pouring tea with a tremor
scenarios.problem: Hand tremor while pouring a hot drink.

vision.seen: Hands are pouring tea from a teapot into a teacup and saucer on a wooden kitchen table.
vision.say_now: You are pouring a cup of tea at the table. Take your time, and sit down comfortably when you are ready.
vision.summary: Pouring tea from a teapot into a cup at the kitchen table.
vision.caregiver_note: Pouring hot tea at the kitchen table without any visible spills.
